accentColorNote: Sampled from the mark's own SVG source, which fills its path with no colour attribute (default black). No official coloured Lamborghini brand-guideline hex could be sourced; the shield/bull crest, which is more commonly associated with the brand's gold, is not available on Commons in a form that identifies a specific hex value either, so the wordmark's own colour is recorded honestly rather than a commonly cited but unsourced gold.
